introHtml: Medium point pens and markers hit the sweet spot between fine and bold, making them the most versatile choice for everyday office use, trade shows, and corporate gifts. Unlike fine points that can feel scratchy or bold points that bleed on cheap paper, medium point products deliver smooth, consistent lines on any surface. Whether you are branding ballpoint pens for a sales team or ordering custom highlighters for a safety training session, medium point ensures legibility without smudging. Decorate with your logo via pad printing or laser engraving for a professional finish that lasts.
